description: The distinct values of one filter column of a dataset, to learn valid filter values before query_dataset. Most useful for code columns (district_code, school_code, county_fips, demographic) and category columns without a fixed list in describe_dataset, where a wrong guess returns an empty page rather than an error. `column` must be one of describe_dataset's `filters`. `prefix` keeps values starting with it (case-insensitive). Columns with a fixed list return it directly; others are read from the data. `truncated` says the list was capped.

detail.description: Level of detail, i.e. what one row describes: 'schools', 'districts', 'counties', 'tracts', 'states', ... (each dataset lists its own). Omit for the dataset's default.
detail.title: Detail

limit.description: Most values to return (default 50, at most 500).
limit.title: Limit

main_topic.description: Subject area: 'education' (the default), 'census', or 'immigration'. A dataset's key starts with it.
main_topic.title: Main Topic

prefix.description: Keep only values starting with this text.
prefix.title: Prefix

topic.description: Dataset name, e.g. 'act_scores' (the last part of a key from list_datasets or search_datasets). The full key, e.g. 'education/gosa/act_scores', also works and sets main_topic.
topic.title: Topic

name: distinct_values
title: List a Filter's Valid Values
